title: Close native bundle links and attribution resources

findings: 28 native manifest paths resolved from hidden directories instead of documented owners.
Three generated native NOTICE links target a canonical font-source document omitted from their self-contained bundle.
reproduction.scope: Generic offline link check of the actual extracted release, independently reproduced by root and the validator worker.
limits: Specialized native validators passing does not waive these broken links. No full52 gate or release pass.

independent-review.author: /root/final_audit
